title: Chapter 1423 - 6: Sudden Wealth

Chapter 1423 - 6: Sudden Wealth

Chapter 1423 - 6: Sudden Wealth

"How can he be this strong?"

The Bald Time Lord was somewhat dumbfounded.

Originally, he thought he had been cautious enough, being a second-tier lord, yet exploring the outskirts of the Wanwei space-time.

It's known that most second-tier lords usually venture deep into the Wanwei space-time.

Gains there, even slightly, can outmatch hundreds of thousands or even millions of years spent exploring the outskirts.

But Lin Yuan?

Just through the suffocating sensation emanating from him, the Bald Time Lord could deduce that Lin Yuan's strength far exceeded his own.

A second-tier lord needs to endure the tribulation of one billion and eight thousand calamities, and the terrifying aura Lin Yuan is exhibiting now is equivalent to that of a powerful lord who has endured five or six hundred million times.

A lord of such prowess, yet not venturing into the deep Wanwei space-time?

"Let me test this move."

Lin Yuan quickly pressed his right hand down; at this moment, he was fully committing himself, directly utilizing 'Tai Chu' from the 'Innate Five Great'.

'Innate Five Great' is a method established by Lin Yuan, gathering all of his own insights from the operation of the Origin Dao of the fourth source world.

It elevates Lin Yuan's strength to a whole new realm. Besides the still-improving 'Tai Shi', 'Tai Chu' is Lin Yuan's strongest move.

If 'Tai Chu' cannot defeat the Bald Time Lord, it means Lin Yuan has no way to deal with him, and splitting half of the Time Mountain is the best choice.

Rumble—

Although it seemed slow, Lin Yuan's attack arrived instantly.

While the Bald Time Lord was shocked by Lin Yuan's strength, he also immediately employed all his means to resist.

Even though he sensed he was not Lin Yuan's match, the Bald Time Lord was unwilling to retreat, after all, it involved such a significant Time Mountain, more than his long years of accumulation.

Unless all hope was lost, naturally the Bald Time Lord wanted to fight.

As long as he could withstand Lin Yuan's attack, then the two would have the capital to negotiate.

At this moment, the Bald Time Lord did not hope to receive half of the Time Mountain; the extent of division depended on his own strength.

If the Bald Time Lord was stronger than Lin Yuan, half of the mountain would be no problem, even more than half.

However, as it stands now, with the inequality of power, the Bald Time Lord dared not think too much.

If he could ultimately secure a tenth, it would still be profitable.

Of course, this premise is if he can withstand Lin Yuan's attack.

Only by withstanding can he force Lin Yuan to concede.

Rumble.

The power of Tai Chu penetrated through layers of space-time. Without the suppression of the Wanwei space-time, the pervasive Tai Chu force would have obliterated everything.

"Me?" The Bald Time Lord's entire body emitted layers of dark light, struggling to resist the omnipresent Tai Chu force, "Upon first contact, a tenth of my physical body was obliterated?"

Though it quickly regenerated the obliterated fraction, it continued to be eroded under the Tai Chu force.

Swish.

The Tai Chu force resembled a vast ocean, and the Bald Time Lord seemed like a solitary boat adrift, prone to capsizing at any moment.

"Too strong."

The Bald Time Lord's heart trembled.

He was utterly no match for Lin Yuan, even simply defending was exceedingly challenging.

"My luck is just too bad."

In his heart, the Bald Time Lord felt helpless, finally discovering a treasure on the outskirts, only to have it fall into the hands of such a formidable entity like Lin Yuan.

At this moment, the Bald Time Lord had a new assessment of Lin Yuan's strength—

At least he was a lord who had survived seven or eight hundred million times of the second-tier tribulation.

The second-tier only consists of one billion and eight thousand calamities, surviving seven or eight hundred million times? Already considered at the pinnacle of this tier.

Of course, the most fearsome existence in the second-tier are those facing the final eight thousand calamities.

One billion eight thousand steps, of which one billion is a threshold, having passed one billion calamities, attempting the final eight thousand marks one's touch upon legendary lord status.

Truth be told, many powerful Time Lords, after surviving up to the ten billionth tribulation of the second-tier, dare not attempt the final eight thousand calamities.

The possibility of failure in the last eight thousand calamities of one billion eight thousand steps is immensely high, and once failed, one would be erased by the Supreme Rule Dao's consciousness.

Buzz~ Tai Chu force dissipated.

The Bald Time Lord's form re-coalesced.

However, his aura was noticeably much weaker now than before.

While he wasn't entirely obliterated under Lin Yuan's 'Innate Five Great' attack with Tai Chu, he wasn't far off.

"Huh?" Lin Yuan observed the Bald Time Lord, estimating his condition.

The 'one move' he mentioned naturally was not just a single move.

But rather using this move to gauge the Bald Time Lord's approximate strength.

"No need to look further, that Time Mountain is yours."

The Bald Time Lord shook his head, saying.

He was now heavily injured, only needing Lin Yuan to deploy that level of technique a few more times—if he didn't flee, the Bald Time Lord basically wouldn't survive.

"I appreciate it."

Lin Yuan said.

"Only because my strength is lesser than yours."

The Bald Time Lord looked at Lin Yuan: "Congratulations on such a gain."

Harvesting a Time Mountain of that size in the outer region truly deserved congratulations.

After saying that, the Bald Time Lord disappeared.

"Gone?"

Lin Yuan sensed the Bald Time Lord's aura fading away, but did not intercept.

Firstly, it might not be stop-able, a fully fleeing second-tier Time Lord, even if pursued, how long would it take?
